articles.title: 3 Chinese sats scanned India’s western coast frequently during Op Sindoor: Desi space surveillance company’s report
articles.summary: An Indian space surveillance report revealed that three Chinese surveillance satellites actively monitored India's western coast, particularly Gujarat, throughout last year's Operation Sindoor. This significant detection raises concerns regarding potential foreign intelligence gathering during crucial national defence exercises, underscoring the vital need for robust space domain awareness and enhanced counter-surveillance capabilities to safeguard India's strategic interests.

articles.title: Turkish military helicopter crash kills five in western Turkiye
articles.summary: A Turkish Air Force helicopter crashed in western Turkiye, resulting in the death of five crew members. The country's Ministry of National Defence confirmed the tragic accident. This incident highlights the inherent risks faced by service personnel during operational duties and underscores the importance of stringent safety protocols within defense forces.

articles.title: Donald Trump a câștigat până la 15 milioane de dolari de pe urma întoarcerii lui Jensen Huang în fruntea Nvidia, pentru care chiar el a intervenit. Președintele deține acțiuni în cadrul companiei, care au crescut, luni, cu peste 30%.
articles.summary: Nvidia's market capitalization witnessed an extraordinary surge of approximately $950 billion, with its stock climbing a remarkable 31.5% on Monday. This substantial growth is largely attributed to CEO Jensen Huang's leadership, reflecting strong investor confidence in the technology giant, renowned for its advancements in AI and graphics processing units, crucial for modern computational power.

articles.title: Name missing from service record no bar to disabled man’s family pension: AFT
articles.summary: The Armed Forces Tribunal (AFT) Chandigarh has ruled that a 68-year-old physically disabled man will receive a lifelong family pension. This significant decision comes over five decades after the death of his soldier father. The ruling provides crucial financial support and acknowledges a long-pending claim, highlighting the tribunal's commitment to ensuring welfare for military dependents, even after extended periods.

articles.title: Putin says retaliation ‘inevitable’ after Ukraine hit Russian oil plants
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin stated that Ukraine continues to attack Russian oil refineries, despite requests from US President Donald Trump to cease operations. Putin warned of retaliation, indicating a potential escalation of the conflict. This situation underscores the ongoing strategic assaults on critical infrastructure and the complex interplay of international diplomacy amidst heightened geopolitical tensions.

articles.title: Delhi Govt Allows Easy Felling of Five Tree Species on Private Land
articles.summary: The Delhi government has issued a gazette notification easing rules for felling five specific tree species, including poplar and safeda, when they are located on private land. This policy change aims to simplify permissions for landowners and streamline processes related to these fast-growing trees. The decision reflects an effort to balance development needs with urban environmental regulations in the national capital.
